senses.gloss: m. (זגג to clear, cmp. זכך a. דכך, v. Ges. Thes. s. v.) glass-maker; dealer in glass-ware.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 13b">M. Kat. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 55b:13">Pes. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>בית הז׳</he> the glass-maker’s work-shop.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:6">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>חנותו של ז׳</he> a glass-dealer’s shop.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 25">Gen. R. s. 25</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זַגָּגִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 24:8">Kel. XXIV, 8</cite> <he>מטה של ז׳</he> the frame used by the glass-makers to put their ware on.
